title: IIT Patna Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT Patna) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Junior Research Fellow positions. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech or M.E/ M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering can grab this chance and apply for the IIT Patna Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply...
